title: UPACanonicalPaymentIntent
description: The exact transaction data contract enforced by the Agentic Payment Control Layer across Phase 5 of the agent lifecycle.

agent_id.description: Unique cryptographic instance identifier assigned during KYA identity registration.

principal_id.description: OIDC subject identifier or bank-issued root token referencing the authorizing human or enterprise.

intent_id.description: Deterministic transaction cycle execution token tracking this specific intent.

legal_name.description: Full registered name of the target merchant or vendor cross-checked against ERP whitelists.

legal_entity_identifier.description: ISO 17442 LEI token string required for automated institutional clearing rails.

routing_identifier.description: Target banking routing data network string (SWIFT BIC, local ABA Routing Transit Number, or Virtual Payment Address).

value.description: Explicit numeric cost parameter parsed by the Fiduciary Translation Engine.

purpose.description: Standardized ISO 20022 ExternalPurpose1Code values parsed dynamically from unstructured context strings.

authority_token.description: Cryptographically signed JWT matching the Section 3.7 Capability Token Profile.

w3c_spc_cryptogram.description: WebAuthn assertion token from user presence validation, cryptographically binding amount and payee variables.

enclave_attestation_signature.description: Hardware measurement signature confirming the runtime has not undergone memory tampering.

idempotency_key.description: Unique key token used to prevent double-spend race conditions over network drops.
